record.question: Which University in the Northeastern States recently got 51st ranked in All India University Ranking results?
record.explanation: Answer D: Mizoram University. Mizoram University ranked 51 st in the overall 2016 NIRF university ranking, with score 60.31. The organizer's original 2016 results identify that rank; component-specific ranks in the same page must not be mistaken for the overall rank. Historical/source note: NIRF 2016 university category and overall result, not a current ranking or a component score. Reference: https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2016/univ.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
